art_instructions: Draw a medium shot from eye level showing Owl playing with friends inside the cozy woodland schoolhouse. Owl is perched on a low desk or windowsill, flapping her wings playfully with a big, joyful smile, her tiny satchel resting nearby. Around her are 2-3 small woodland animal friends—perhaps a rabbit, a squirrel, and a hedgehog—sitting or standing close, also smiling and engaged in play. The classroom background includes wooden desks and shelves filled with picture books, with a chalkboard visible on one wall. Sunlight streams through wide windows, illuminating the scene warmly. All characters are drawn in Korean aegyo cute style: round eyes, chibi proportions (2-3 heads tall), pastel colors, and smooth monoline strokes. The school’s interior features wooden walls, a soft rug on the floor, and cheerful yellow window frames, as described in the school location guide.
